If you want R-03 built, say so explicitly (e.g. "yes, implement R-03 / list --json") and I'll run `/pincer-plan` to fold it into a new PRD version, then `/pincer-narrow` and `/pincer-code` to ticket and implement it — that's the required path per this repo's rules for post-evaluation/scope changes. Otherwise, next step per the workflow is `/pincer-evaluate` for a final quality pass on what's built.
